verdict.rationale: A built-in AI assistant is a fair question for a SaaS identity platform like Entra ID, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents an in-product AI assistant that users can delegate tasks to. The MCP server probe concerns Microsoft Learn documentation access, a different story and not an in-product assistant, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
